T: Life is like a box of chocolates. So is this menu.
D: A kind man from Alabama ends up at the centre of decades of American history.
P: Serve the prawns when Bubba starts listing all the ways to cook shrimp.
S: Handmade dark chocolates filled with caramel, raspberry ganache or peanut butter
Dark chocolate tempered and poured into moulds, filled with salted caramel, raspberry ganache and peanut butter, set and mixed in a box.
Skewered prawns brushed with smoked paprika garlic butter, lemon to squeeze
Green prawns skewered, brushed with butter, garlic, paprika and cayenne, grilled 2 minutes a side, lemon squeezed over.
Bus stop ham and honey mustard biscuits

Flaky buttermilk biscuits split warm and filled with shaved leg ham, a sweet honey mustard butter and a little sharp cheddar. Rub 100g cold butter into 300g plain flour with 3 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, fold the dough over itself three times and pat to 2cm. Cut 8 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Beat 40g soft butter with 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp Dijon. Split the warm biscuits, spread with the butter and fill with 200g shaved ham and sliced cheddar.
M: Dark roux gumbo with smoked sausage, vegetables and prawns
Dark roux of oil and flour stirred 30 minutes, onion, celery and capsicum, garlic, stock and smoked sausage, simmered an hour, prawns in for 3 minutes. Rice.

Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged in spiced flour, fried crunchy, with garlicky greens and buttery mash. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Mix 300g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp pepper and salt. Dredge the chicken and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Mash 1kg potatoes with 80g butter. Saute 2 bunches silverbeet or kale with garlic and a splash of vinegar.
W: Cinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice cream
Sliced peaches with sugar and cinnamon, buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Cherry and vanilla syrup over ice, topped up with soda

Homemade cherry and vanilla syrup topped with cold soda water and a squeeze of lime, over ice with a cherry on top. Simmer 300g pitted cherries, fresh or frozen, with 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and a split vanilla bean for 10 minutes. Mash, strain and cool the syrup. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 50ml syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, top with 200ml cold soda water and stir. Finish with a cherry.

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and paint it into chocolate moulds. Set.
Fill some moulds with caramel melted with a little cream, some with raspberry ganache and some with peanut butter.
Seal with more chocolate and set.
Pack them in a box and mix them up.
Peel the prawns and thread onto skewers.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic, paprika and cayenne and brush over.
Grill, turning once, and squeeze lemon over.
Stir the oil and flour over medium heat into a dark roux.
Dice the onion, celery and capsicum and slice the sausage. Peel the prawns.
Add the vegetables and garlic to the roux, then the stock and sausage. Simmer.
Cook the rice.
Add the prawns to the gumbo for the last few minutes and serve over the rice.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day it is baked

steps.text: Slice the peaches and toss with the sugar and cinnamon in a dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, add the milk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit.
Bake at 190C.
Serve with vanilla ice cream.
Simmer the cherries with the sugar, water and split vanilla bean.
Mash, strain and cool the syrup.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with cold soda water, stir, and finish with a cherry.

s.note: Handmade dark chocolates filled with caramel, raspberry ganache or peanut butter
s.how: Paint chocolate moulds with 250g melted dark chocolate and set. Fill some with caramel melted with a little cream, some with raspberry ganache and some with peanut butter. Seal with more chocolate, set and mix them up in a box.

s.note: Skewered prawns brushed with smoked paprika garlic butter, lemon to squeeze
s.how: Thread 600g peeled green prawns onto skewers. Brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of cayenne. Grill 2 minutes a side and squeeze lemon over.

m.note: Dark roux gumbo with smoked sausage, vegetables and prawns
m.how: Stir 80ml oil and 80g flour over medium heat for 30 minutes into a dark roux. Add an onion, 2 celery sticks and a capsicum, then garlic, 1L stock and 250g sliced smoked sausage. Simmer an hour, add 500g prawns for 3 minutes. Serve over 300g rice.

w.note: Cinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Cherry and vanilla syrup over ice, topped up with soda
d.how: Simmer 300g pitted cherries, fresh or frozen, with 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and a split vanilla bean for 10 minutes. Mash, strain and cool the syrup. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 50ml syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, top with 200ml cold soda water and stir. Finish with a cherry.
